svg.title: Kshana
svg.desc: Kshana, pnt-resilience simulator. Open, reproducible simulation of positioning, navigation & timing when GNSS is denied. 130 of 260 validated against external oracles. kshana.dev · quantum · inertial · optical · AGPL-3.0.
